chatbot.title: Scheme Assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Ask about schemes, eligibility, or documents
chatbot.greeting: Hi! I can help explain schemes, eligibility, required documents, or how to apply. What would you like to know?
chatbot.docs: Required documents vary by scheme, but commonly include Aadhaar, an income certificate, and a caste/category certificate if applicable. Open a scheme's detail page to see its exact 'Required Documents' list, or visit your Wallet to upload and verify them.
chatbot.apply: Each scheme's detail page has an 'Application Process' section and an 'Apply Officially' button that takes you to the real government application site — applications aren't submitted through this app.
chatbot.eligibility: Eligibility is checked against each scheme's official criteria (age, income, category, etc.) using your profile. Open any scheme to see a 'Why You Match' breakdown, or complete your Profile for more accurate results.
chatbot.found: I found {{count}} scheme(s) that might match: {{names}}. Try searching for these on the home page to see full details.
chatbot.notFound: I couldn't find anything specific on that in the current scheme data. Try rephrasing, or browse categories on the home page — I don't want to guess at something I'm not sure about.
chatbot.error: I'm having trouble reaching scheme data right now. Please try again in a moment.
